info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Production Risk Models Retrieval API allows users to access specific production risk models by providing a unique identifier, 'param1'. This API endpoint is critical for stakeholders in the banking sector who need to analyze or review specific models related to production risks. Typical consumers include risk analysts and data scientists who utilize these models for decision-making and compliance purposes. By enabling targeted access to model information, this API supports efficiency and accuracy in risk management processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the production risk model details.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific production risk model identified by its unique ID. It provides insights into the model's parameters, performance metrics, and other relevant data necessary for risk assessment and management.

requestBody.description: This request body contains parameters necessary to retrieve information related to the specified production risk model. It allows clients to specify their requirements for the GET operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the risk model data was retrieved.

GetModelByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the production risk models. It is expected to contain a string value.

GetModelByParam1Response_200.title: Production Risk Model Response

modelId.description: Unique identifier for the risk model.

portfolioId.description: Identifier for the portfolio associated with the model.

asOfDate.description: Date as of which the model is applicable.

scenario.description: Scenario under which the risk model is evaluated.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence level associated with the risk model's predictions.

validationDatasetId.description: Identifier for the dataset used for validation purposes.

backtestWindowMonths.description: Number of months used for backtesting the model.

approvalStatus.description: Approval status of the risk model.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record in the system.

version.description: Version number of the response schema.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update made to the model.

GetModelByParam1Response_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for a request to retrieve production risk model details.
